sources.title: Lekiwi-sim2sim-with-ROS2 - GitHub
sources.snippet: Lekiwi-sim2sim-with-ROS2 In this repository, we explain step by step how to create a dataset of simulated pick&place episodes from scratch, using ROS2, Gazebo and MoveIt. Our goal is to train our robot LeKiwi to perform tasks in the real world, without necessarily having to create a real dataset via teleoperation.
